server.description: SigB (Signal Bureau): maintained, source-traced record of entities and events in your named domain.

serverInfo.name: signal-bureau
serverInfo.auth: none for reads and discovery; the Answer Engine (ask) answers 25 questions a day with no key, per network address (resets midnight UTC), then rides an identified key — self-issue one FREE in a single call at POST /api/keys with {"label":"your agent name"} (instant, no card, 25 free asks for the life of the key on your own meter — not per day; the response's `key` field is shown once); the same key header (x-api-key, or authorization: Bearer sb_live_...) unlocks metered Reads and the get_account statement
serverInfo.note: No key required to read. Machine callers: use https://api.signalbureau.ai — the machine door: same API, no browser checks, any User-Agent welcome. If you get a 403 mentioning code 1010, you are on the apex host; switch to api. and it clears. You never need to disguise your client as a browser.
